text:
我是个大气物理学家
I’m an atmospheric physicist.

我发表了超过 200 篇科学论文
I’ve published more than 200 scientific papers.

我在 MIT 任教了 30 年
For 30 years I taught at MIT,

这期间气候变化极小
during which time the climate has changed remarkably little.

但「全球变暖」的呼声愈演愈烈
But the cry of “global warming” has grown ever more shrill.

实际上 似乎气候变化越小
In fact, it seems that the less the climate changes,

气候危言耸听者的声音就越大
the louder the voices of the climate alarmists get.

那么 让我们一起消除误解 营造一幅更准确的图景
So, let’s clear the air and create a more accurate picture

我们究竟如何看待全球变暖
of where we really stand on the issue of global warming

或现在被称为 「气候变化」
or, as it is now called—“climate change.”

大概有三个群体的人关注这个问题
There are basically three groups of people dealing with this issue.

群体 1 和 2 是科学家
Groups one and two are scientists.

群体 3 最主要由政客 环保主义者和媒体组成
Group three consists mostly, at its core, of politicians, environmentalists and the media.

群体 1
Group one is

和联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会的科学部门
associated with the scientific part of the United Nation’s International Panel on Climate Change

（IPCC 第一工作组） 有关
or IPCC (Working Group 1).

这些科学家大多认为
These are scientists who mostly believe

近来气候变化主要是因为人类燃烧化石燃料
that recent climate change is primarily due to man’s burning of fossil fuels—

石油 煤和天然气
oil, coal and natural gas.

这些燃料释放出二氧化碳到大气中
This releases C02, carbon dioxide, into the atmosphere

而且他们相信 这可能最终导致地球危险变热
and, they believe, this might eventually dangerously heat the planet.

群体 2 由不认为这是个严重问题的科学家组成
Group two is made up of scientists who don’t see this as an especially serious problem.

我属于这个群体
This is the group I belong to.

我们通常被称为怀疑论者
We’re usually referred to as skeptics.

我们注意到有许多因素导致气候变化
We note that there are many reasons why the climate changes

太阳 云 海洋 地球轨道变更 还有无数其他因素
the sun, clouds, oceans, the orbital variations of the earth, as well as a myriad of other inputs.

没有一样是已完全了解的
None of these is fully understood,

也没有证据表明二氧化碳排放是主要因素
and there is no evidence that CO2 emissions are the dominant factor.

但其实这两个群体的科学家之间拥有不少共识
But actually there is much agreement between both groups of scientists.

如下所列：
The following are such points of agreement:

1）气候是不断变化的
1) The climate is always changing.

2）二氧化碳是温室气体 没有它地球就不会存在生命
2) CO2 is a greenhouse gas without which life on earth is not possible,

但把它加入到大气中会导致气候稍微变暖
but adding it to the atmosphere should lead to some warming.

3）自 19 世纪小冰期结束以来大气中的二氧化碳浓度一直在上升
3) Atmospheric levels of CO2 have been increasing since the end of the Little Ice Age in the 19th century.

4）在这段时间（过去两个世纪）
4) Over this period (the past two centuries),

全球的平均温度略微不定地上升了
the global mean temperature has increased slightly and erratically

约 1.8 华氏度或 1 摄氏度
by about 1.8 degrees Fahrenheit or one degree Celsius;

但从 1960 年代开始人类温室排放才足以发挥作用
but only since the 1960’s have man’s greenhouse emissions been sufficient to play a role.

5）考虑到气候的复杂性
5) Given the complexity of climate,

无法作出关于未来全球平均温度及其影响的可靠预测
no confident prediction about future global mean temperature or its impact can be made.

IPCC 在其 2007 年度报告中承认
The IPCC acknowledged in its own 2007 report

「关于未来气候变化的长期预测是不可能的」
that “The long-term prediction of future climate states is not possible.”

更重要的是
Most importantly,

两个群体都没有断言燃烧化石燃料会导致灾难
the scenario that the burning of fossil fuel leads to catastrophe isn’t part of what either group asserts.

那为啥那么多人担忧 确切地说 惊慌于这一议题呢？
So why are so many people worried, indeed, panic stricken about this issue.

这时群体 3 登场了
Here’s where Group Three comes in

政客 环保主义者和媒体
the politicians, environmentalists, and media.

全球变暖危言耸听比起其他议题 最能带来他们最想要的东西
Global warming alarmism provides them, more than any other issue, with the things they most want:

对于政客来说是金钱和权力
For politicians it’s money and power.

对于环保主义者来说是他们组织需要的金钱
For environmentalists it’s money for their organizations

和证实他们近乎宗教虔诚的想法
and confirmation of their near religious devotion

即人类对于自然是一股破坏性力量
to the idea that man is a destructive force acting upon nature.

而对于媒体来说则是意识形态 金钱和头条
And for the media it’s ideology, money, and headlines.

世界末日论是能赚大钱的
Doomsday scenarios sell.

同时 过去十年
Meanwhile, over the last decade,

气候物理学外的科学家也紧跟潮流
scientists outside of climate physics have jumped on the bandwagon,

发表论文把从痤疮到叙利亚内战的所有事情归咎于全球变暖
publishing papers blaming global warming for everything from acne to the Syrian civil war.

权贵资本家急切抓住机遇
And crony capitalists have eagerly grabbed for the subsidies

获取政府提供的慷慨补贴
that governments have so lavishly provided.

不幸的是 群体 3 正在赢得这场争论
Unfortunately, group three is winning the argument

因为他们淹没了应该继续下去的严肃讨论
because they have drowned out the serious debate that should be going on.

但即便政客 环保主义者和各路媒体
But while politicians, environmentalists and media types

能够浪费大量金钱 恐吓住大多数人
can waste a lot of money and scare a lot of people,

他们也无法掩埋真相
they won’t be able to bury the truth.

最终还是气候说了算
The climate will have the final word on that.

我是理查德·林德森 麻省理工的大气科学系名誉教授
I’m Richard Lindzen, emeritus professor of atmospheric sciences at MIT,

为 PragerU 制作
for Prager University.
